activation_conditions: User is pregnant or may be pregnant and current or proposed supplement contains preformed vitamin A.
missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend or calculate an additional vitamin A supplement until retinol/retinyl ester versus beta-carotene composition and total intake are known.
safety_exclusions: Do not treat beta-carotene as equivalent to preformed retinol.
Do not infer that all vitamin A forms carry identical reproductive risk.
Do not independently alter a prescribed prenatal product.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy or possible pregnancy with high-dose preformed vitamin A exposure.
Unknown formulation or total daily intake; use of retinoid medicines.
population_and_context: Pregnancy and potential pregnancy; preformed vitamin A specifically, with age-specific upper limits.
dose_constraints: No personalized dose from this rule; assess preformed vitamin A contribution and clinician-managed prenatal needs.
certainty_and_limitations: Source-linked claim remains in evidence_review status. Distinguish preformed vitamin A from provitamin A carotenoids and verify the product label.
